title: Chunked File Upload
description: Implement a resumable chunked file upload system with initialization, chunk upload with progress tracking, assembly, and verification.

steps.title: Initialize upload
steps.description: Implement POST /upload/init that accepts metadata (filename, totalSize, mimeType) and returns 201 with a unique uploadId that subsequent chunk requests will use.
hints: Generate a unique uploadId (UUID or sequential)
Store the upload session with metadata

steps.title: Upload chunk
steps.description: Implement POST /upload/:uploadId/chunk that receives a binary chunk, appends it to the session, and returns 200 with the current progress (receivedSize, totalSize).
hints: Read raw binary from request body
Append chunk buffer to the session's chunks array

steps.title: Upload progress
steps.description: Implement GET /upload/:uploadId that returns the current upload progress: received bytes, total bytes, and completion percentage.
hints: Look up the session by uploadId

steps.title: Complete upload assembly
steps.description: Implement POST /upload/:uploadId/complete that concatenates all received chunks into the final file, stores it, and returns 200 with file details.
hints: Concatenate all chunks in order into a single buffer
Store the final file accessible by its original name

steps.title: Verify assembled file
steps.description: Implement GET /files/:name that returns the assembled file. Verify that the complete file can be downloaded correctly.
hints: Retrieve the assembled file from the files store
